fields.Name: W8 -> S3.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.27 (phase 2, dataset W8, criterion S3.4): with shuffled labels, the target-encoded high-cardinality feature of W8-highcard s42 scores a held-out AUC whose 95% interval covers 0.5, 1 of 1. The gate exercises the sidecar's in-fold target encoder on a W8 snapshot built by the test fixture (the product's snapshot assembler emits one-hot encodings only, so a target-encoded column is not reachable from a product snapshot yet). It fails when the target encoder is fitted on all rows before the folds, so the shuffled-label AUC interval excludes 0.5.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: With shuffled labels, a logistic regression on the in-fold target-encoded 400-level PostalCode of W8-highcard s42 scores a held-out AUC whose 95% Hanley-McNeil interval covers 0.5 (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
